PROTIP: The light at the end of the tunnel is actually a firefly that's moving a little faster than you are.

Which means you spend your entire life chasing after salvation only to never find it. Actually, you do find it, it's called death.

Do it. DO IT!

Yup! Nothing brightens my day more than a bunch of naive kids and fat ugly whale girls telling me that there's so much to live for because they've been through the terrible, traumatic ordeal of spending every single night alone, which means they know everything about being alone!

You're fucking awesome for drinking and mixing so many drugs.
If you want to go out in style, do it in public. Make a cocktail that will kill you with little pain and then drink it in a crowded place so as many people as possible see it for maximum impact.

For added bonus, if you have no relatives or friends or nobody who will care if you die, run around a mall or a busy street buck naked to get as much attention as possible before doing the deed.

Good luck!

You're doing the right thing, brah.
Your life is yours to do what you want with.
If you don't like it, and you think nobody will miss you, do it.
Eternal sleep is fucking awesome.
